integrity: The all-dimensional proof uses an odd-cycle lower bound and exact unweighted and magnetization-weighted eight-state determinant coefficients. A standalone symbolic checker validates those identities over exact polynomial rings, plus labelled-graph brute force and transfer comparisons. Finite checks do not replace the proof. The n=10 dodecahedron specialization was published in 2015; only the general n congruent 2 modulo 4 law and its systematic magnetization profile are claimed as new. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for simple GP(n,2) with n congruent to 2 modulo 4 and n at least 6, homogeneous antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbor Ising spins at zero field. It excludes other congruence classes, inhomogeneous couplings, field and temperature effects. The n=10 specialization and the general zero-field Potts transfer-matrix framework have prior literature.
title: Odd-inner-ring Ising ground-state counts and magnetization profiles on generalized Petersen graphs
